value.rationale: A 2023 primary paper explicitly motivates incidence geometry of all 28 bitangents in this symmetric pencil and establishes only a lower bound on quadruple concurrence plus three isolated examples. The new theorem completely determines when triple intersections arise, identifies exactly 24 exceptional smooth members and provides natural polynomial equations for their 4/12/24 strata, plus two symmetry jump strata. It replaces isolated examples with a complete parameter-space discriminant; these exact roots are required to navigate changes in the intersection lattice and are not arbitrary sample values.
